candidate.definition_en: To shout for joy or in praise of someone; to comfort or encourage.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تهتف وتشجع حد بصوت عالي، أو تحاول تبسط حد وتفرحه.

senses.definition_en: To shout loudly to encourage, praise, or show support for someone.
senses.definition_ar: أن تهتف بصوت عالٍ لتشجيع شخص أو إظهار الدعم والإعجاب به.
examples: We cheer for our team whenever they play at home.
The crowd began to cheer as the players walked onto the pitch.

senses.definition_en: To make someone feel happier, more cheerful, or less worried.
senses.definition_ar: أن تُبهج شخصاً أو ترفع معنوياته وتجعله يشعر بالسعادة.
examples: I tried to cheer him up with a joke, but he was still upset.
We cheer for our team whenever they play at home.
I tried to cheer him up with a joke, but he was still upset.
The crowd began to cheer as the players walked onto the pitch.
